name: Old Kinderhook Resort, Golf, Club & Spa
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from opengolfapi, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Web. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: hole 15 is played as a 273-yd hole from a forward tee (card says 402). Hole 9 tee is off the line (minor).

9: Page tee is a lidar pad in the woods ~22 yds left of the hole line and only ~8 yds behind its start, not a back tee. The OSM hole line starts on a visible tee pad (505 yds to the green vs card 514).
15: Card says 273 but the club's hole-by-hole guide gives 402-365-332-293 (the other columns of that guide sum to the club totals; a 273 back tee would be shorter than the 365 Club tee; and the hole is described with water…
